project.name: JamboScript
project.description: Interactive children's coding platform (ages 9–12) teaching programming through a Swahili-language adventure story. Three characters guide the player on a quest to restore a magical Code Tree.
project.art_style: Warm, friendly children's book illustration. Think Studio Ghibli meets Kurzgesagt. Soft rounded shapes, bold outlines (2–3px), no sharp or threatening edges. East African-inspired without being stereotypical.
project.cultural_inspiration: East African (Swahili coast) — subtle kanga/kitenge textile patterns as geometric accents (diamonds, chevrons, zigzags). Not dominant, just flavor.

svg_requirements.format: Pure inline SVG code — no raster images, no <image> tags, no external assets
svg_requirements.defs_note: Place all gradients, patterns, and reusable clip-paths inside a <defs> block
svg_requirements.structure_rule: Every animatable body part MUST be wrapped in its own <g id='part-name'> group. These groups will be converted to Framer Motion <motion.g> elements for animation. Each group needs a logical transform origin.
svg_requirements.style_note: Use SVG attributes (fill, stroke, etc.) not CSS style attributes

characters.name: Kito
characters.role: The Friendly Guide Tortoise — player's coding mentor and best friend
characters.personality: Warm, encouraging, patient, curious. Like a kind elementary school teacher who happens to be an adorable tortoise. Never condescending.

visual_design.species: Anthropomorphic tortoise, standing upright on 2 legs (not 4). Cute chibi proportions — head is ~35% of total height.
visual_design.build: Short and round. Compact, friendly silhouette.
visual_design.pose: ¾ front-facing view, slight friendly lean forward

body.description: Main torso — round dome shell viewed from ¾ front. Shell has 3 curved horizontal segment lines. Small gold (#FACC15) diamond accents on shell inspired by kanga textile patterns. Lighter belly patch on front.
body.animation: Gentle breathing bob — slow Y oscillation (3.5s cycle), subtle squash/stretch on celebrate

head.description: Oval head, slightly oversized (cute proportions). Soft rounded snout. Two rosy cheek circles. Nested inside body group for secondary motion (delayed bounce).
head.animation: Secondary bounce with 0.15s delay from body. Slight tilt when speaking.

eye_left.description: Large round eye. White sclera, dark navy iris (#1E1B4B), small white catchlight dot at 10 o'clock position.
eye_left.animation: Periodic blink (scaleY keyframes: 1→0.1→1 every ~5s). Pupil darts subtly.

eye_right.description: Same as left eye, mirrored position.
eye_right.animation: Blinks in sync with left eye.

mouth.description: Friendly smile as an SVG <path>. Gentle upward curve for idle, opens wider when speaking, big grin when celebrating.
mouth.animation: SVG path 'd' attribute morphing between idle/speaking/celebrating shapes

states.speaking: Opens and closes — alternates between open 'O' and smile

hat.description: Small round safari/explorer hat. Gold (#D4A017) with darker band (#B8860B). Sits at a slightly jaunty angle on top of head.
hat.animation: Extra-delayed secondary motion (0.25s after head). Springy bounce on celebrate.

leg_left.description: Short stubby tortoise leg. Same green as skin.
leg_left.animation: Subtle rotation — slight walking idle motion

tail.description: Small pointed tail poking out behind shell.

shell_pattern.description: Decorative kanga-inspired diamond pattern accents on shell surface. Gold (#FACC15) small diamonds/dots arranged along shell segment lines.

celebration_effects.description: 3–5 small sparkle/star particles that burst outward from body, staggered delays

speaking_effects.description: 2–3 small dots that float upward near the head (thought/speech indicator)

characters.name: Mzee Byte
characters.role: The Wise Elder Sage — keeper of ancient coding knowledge
characters.personality: Deeply wise, calm, speaks in proverbs and riddles. Slow and deliberate — every gesture has meaning. Warm grandfather energy.
characters.swahili_meaning: 'Mzee' means 'elder' or 'respected old person' in Swahili

visual_design.species: Elderly humanoid figure. Not a specific animal — more of a wise sage/wizard archetype with East African aesthetic.
visual_design.build: Tall and lean, slightly stooped with age. Dignified posture.
visual_design.pose: ¾ front-facing, leaning slightly on staff, one hand free for gestures

body.description: Main torso wrapped in flowing indigo/midnight-blue robes (kanzu-inspired). Robes reach to feet. Gold (#FACC15) geometric trim lines along collar, chest, and hem — Swahili henna-inspired motifs. Subtle fold lines for fabric feel.
body.animation: Slow dignified sway — gentle Y oscillation (3.5s cycle). Minimal movement — he's an elder.

robe_hem.description: Bottom edge of robes — wavy flowing hem line as SVG path.
robe_hem.animation: Gentle wave ripple — path 'd' morphing to simulate cloth movement

robe_trim.description: Gold decorative trim lines along collar, chest bands, and hem. 2–3 horizontal curved lines with small geometric accents.

arm_left.description: Left arm — the 'gesture' arm. Robe sleeve covers most of arm, hand visible at end. Warm brown skin.
arm_left.animation: Gestures when speaking — path 'd' morphing to raise/lower hand. Idle: relaxed at side.

arm_right.description: Right arm — holds the staff. Mostly hidden by robe, hand grips staff mid-height.

head.description: Rounded head, warm brown skin (#A07D1C) with slightly darker shadow (#8B6914). Elderly proportions — not chibi like Kito. Head is ~25% of total height.
head.animation: Secondary bounce with 0.15s delay. Slight nod when speaking, dignified tilt on celebrate.

eye_left.description: Slightly narrowed eye (wise/knowing expression). White sclera, amber iris (#F59E0B). Small white catchlight.
eye_left.animation: Slow wise blinks (scaleY). Iris brightens (#FBBF24) when speaking.

eyebrow_left.description: Expressive arched eyebrow as SVG path.
eyebrow_left.animation: Raises when speaking (path 'd' morph upward). Arches dramatically when celebrating.

mouth.description: Subtle, wise mouth. Small gentle curve — he speaks through words, not exaggerated mouth movement. Stroke only, no fill.
mouth.animation: Subtle path morph when speaking — slight open/close. Wider gentle smile on celebrate.

beard.description: Long flowing white beard, extends from jawline down past chin. Multi-layered: outer beard (white, 92% opacity) and inner beard (#F5F5F5). 2 wispy strand details at bottom tips.
beard.animation: Multi-segment flowing motion — path 'd' morphing with staggered delays. Outer layer: 3.5s cycle. Inner layer: 3.5s cycle with 0.2s delay. Wisps: 3s cycle with 0.3–0.5s delays. Bounces more when celebrating.

kofia.description: Traditional kofia (cap) — teal (#14B8A6) with gold (#FACC15) horizontal band and 3 small gold dots along the band. Rounded dome shape sitting on top of head.
kofia.animation: Extra-delayed secondary bounce (0.25s after head). Jaunty tilt on celebrate.

staff.description: Tall wooden walking staff — dark wood (#8B6914) with lighter highlight line (#A07D1C). Runs from above head to ground level. Held by right hand.

staff_orb.description: Glowing teal (#14B8A6) orb at top of staff. Solid inner sphere (r=5) with soft radial gradient glow halo (r=8–10). Small white catchlight sparkle inside orb.
staff_orb.animation: Pulsing glow — radius and opacity oscillate. Brightens significantly when speaking (orb is his 'magic'). Bursts with larger glow on celebrate.

feet.description: Two dark indigo (#2D2A5E) sandal/shoe ellipses at base of robes.

celebration_effects.description: 6 teal magic rune/sparkle characters (✦) that orbit outward from the staff orb in a radial burst pattern, staggered delays

speaking_effects.description: 2–3 small teal circles that rise upward from the staff orb — representing wisdom/magic energy

characters.name: Shida
characters.role: The Mischievous Bug-Creature — playful antagonist who corrupts code
characters.personality: Mischievous, chaotic, silly. A digital gremlin who trips over his own pranks. CRITICAL: Must be FUNNY, not scary. Kids should find Shida frustrating but endearing.

visual_design.species: Blocky bug-creature. 8-bit/pixel-art inspired but with rounded edges so it's not threatening. Think cute ladybug crossed with a retro game enemy.
visual_design.build: Compact rectangular body with rounded corners. 6 small legs (3 per side). Two wiggly antennae.
visual_design.pose: Front-facing, slightly tilted (mischievous lean), floating/hovering (no ground contact)

aura_outer.description: Outer rotating dashed ellipse — like a radar ring. Red (#EF4444) at 30% opacity, stroke-dasharray='4 4'.

aura_inner.description: Inner counter-rotating dashed ellipse — lighter red (#F87171) at 20% opacity, stroke-dasharray='2 6'. Slightly smaller than outer.
aura_inner.animation: Continuous -360° rotation (12s cycle, linear ease). Counter-rotates against outer ring.

body.description: Main body — rounded rectangle (rx=8). Dark maroon (#7F1D1D) outline rect with slightly inset red (#DC2626) fill rect. Thin blue (#3B82F6, 15% opacity) strip on left edge and green (#10B981, 15% opacity) strip on right edge for RGB-shift glitch effect.
body.animation: Jittery erratic hovering — NOT smooth like the other characters. Quick, chaotic Y and X oscillation with slight rotation jitter (2s cycle). Squash/stretch on speaking and celebrating.

scanline_1.description: Horizontal glitch scan-line stripe across upper body. Light red (#FCA5A5) at 40% opacity, 3px tall.
scanline_1.animation: X position jitters left/right (simulates display glitch). Opacity flickers more aggressively when speaking.

scanline_2.description: Second scan-line, middle of body. 2px tall, 25% opacity.
scanline_2.animation: Same X jitter, different timing offset

scanline_3.description: Third scan-line, lower body. 2.5px tall, 30% opacity.
scanline_3.animation: Same X jitter, third timing offset

eye_left.description: LARGER eye (asymmetric — left is bigger than right). Circle r=8 dark sclera, r=6 golden yellow iris, r=2.5 dark pupil, small white catchlight. The bigger eye makes Shida look goofy, not menacing.
eye_left.animation: Periodic blink (scaleY). Pupil darts around shifty — different timing from right eye.

eye_right.description: SMALLER eye (r=6 sclera, r=4.5 iris, r=2 pupil). Positioned slightly higher than left eye to increase asymmetric goofiness.
eye_right.animation: Same blink timing as left, but pupil darts independently (0.15s delay offset).

mouth.description: Wide zig-zag grin — like a jack-o-lantern but cute. 3 peaks in the zigzag pattern. Stroke only (#1E1B4B, 2.5px), no fill. NOT menacing — silly and mischievous.
mouth.animation: Path 'd' morphing when speaking — opens/closes rapidly. Widens more when celebrating. Celebrating also reveals 3 small white rounded teeth rectangles (cute, not fangs).

antenna_left.description: Left antenna — line from top-left of body curving upward and left. Red (#DC2626) stalk (2.5px stroke), golden yellow (#FBBF24) orb at tip (r=4.5). Faint yellow glow circle behind orb (r=7, 15% opacity).
antenna_left.animation: Wobbly independent bounce — position oscillates in both X and Y. Goes wild (faster, larger amplitude) when celebrating.

antenna_right.description: Right antenna — mirrors left but curves upward and right. Same styling.
antenna_right.animation: Same wobble but INDEPENDENT TIMING (different duration: 2.1s vs 1.8s for left). This makes the antennae look alive and uncoordinated — very Shida.

legs.description: 6 small legs total — 3 on left side, 3 on right side of body, evenly spaced vertically. Each leg is a short line (3px stroke, maroon #7F1D1D) with a small circle foot (#991B1B, r=1.5) at the tip. Legs extend outward from body sides at slight downward angles.
legs.animation: Scuttling motion — each leg oscillates in X and Y with staggered delays (i * 0.15s). Left and right legs are offset by 0.08s. Scuttles FASTER when celebrating.

celebration_effects.description: 8 small pixel squares that burst radially outward from body center in all 8 compass directions. Alternating red (#EF4444) and yellow (#FBBF24). They spin (rotate 180°) as they fly out and fade to 0 opacity.

speaking_effects.description: 3 small lightning-bolt/spark shapes that fly upward from near the head. Yellow (#FBBF24) stroke, no fill. Quick 0.8s cycle.

glitch_particles.description: 5 small floating pixel rectangles that continuously drift upward from the body and fade out. Alternating red shades (#EF4444, #F87171). Variable sizes (2–4px). Faster and more intense when speaking.

prompt_instructions: Generate three separate pure SVG code blocks — one for each character. Follow the viewBox, colors, body part grouping (with g id attributes), and structural requirements exactly. The SVGs will be embedded directly in React components and animated with Framer Motion. Keep shapes clean and paths simple. Prioritize charm and readability over realism.
